metadata.title: EBIOS RM-inspired Risk Analysis — Information System
metadata.description: Information system risk analysis structured with an approach inspired by EBIOS RM (French ANSSI) and aligned with the spirit of ISO 27005. It illustrates, on a likelihood×severity matrix, the identification of risk sources, scenarios and a treatment plan, without reproducing all of the method's workshops 1 to 5. The scope includes the business IS, hosting, the workstation fleet and partner interconnections. Assessments express likelihood (probability) and severity (impact) on a 4×4 grid; residual risk accounts for security measures in place or planned. This file is an illustrative, fictional demonstration analysis.
metadata.author: C. Martin
metadata.scope: Business IS — critical digital services (business, hosting, workstations, partner interconnections)
metadata.methodology_reference: Inspired by EBIOS RM (ANSSI) and ISO 27005

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Minimal likelihood: the scenario seems hardly feasible; the risk source is unlikely to act or the operating mode is very difficult to carry out.

levels.label: Significant
levels.description: Significant likelihood: the scenario seems possible; the risk source may act and the operating mode remains feasible with moderate effort.

levels.label: High
levels.description: High likelihood: the scenario has a good chance of occurring; the risk source is motivated and equipped, and the operating mode is feasible without major difficulty.

levels.label: Maximal
levels.description: Maximal likelihood: the scenario is very likely to occur, possibly repeatedly; the operating mode is easy and the risk source determined.

levels.label: Minor
levels.description: Minor severity: no significant operational impact, nor on the safety of people and property. The organization overcomes the situation without difficulty.

levels.label: Significant
levels.description: Significant severity: degradation of activity performance, without impact on the safety of people and property. The organization overcomes the situation despite some difficulties (degraded mode).

levels.label: Serious
levels.description: Serious severity: strong degradation of activity performance, with possible significant impacts on the safety of people and property. The organization overcomes the situation only with serious difficulties (severely degraded mode).

levels.label: Critical
levels.description: Critical severity: the organization is unable to carry out all or part of its activity, with possible serious impacts on the safety of people and property. The organization's survival may be threatened.

criticality_levels.label: Low
criticality_levels.description: Low risk: acceptable as is against the risk acceptance criteria; to be monitored during reviews.

criticality_levels.label: Moderate
criticality_levels.description: Moderate risk: tolerable under conditions; mitigation measures to be considered based on a cost/benefit analysis.

criticality_levels.label: High
criticality_levels.description: High risk: must be treated; security measures are planned and tracked to bring it down to an acceptable level.

criticality_levels.label: Critical
criticality_levels.description: Critical risk: unacceptable against the risk acceptance criteria; priority and immediate treatment required.

risks.label: Customer data breach
risks.description: Scenario: an attacker exploits a stolen privileged account or an application vulnerability to exfiltrate the customer database. Attack path: phishing → lateral movement → database access → exfiltration. Feared event: massive disclosure of personal data.
risks.comment: Most sensitive asset of the IS (GDPR). Enhanced monitoring of privileged access and exfiltrated volumes.

risks.label: Main server failure
risks.description: Hardware or software failure of the server hosting critical services, causing prolonged downtime. Feared event: interruption of business services.
risks.comment: Historical single point of failure, being hardened through redundancy and a DRP.

risks.label: Loss of a key skill
risks.description: Unanticipated departure of an expert holding critical, poorly documented knowledge (administration of a business application). Feared event: loss of control and continuity.
risks.comment: Dependence on a single person (bus factor = 1); documentation and pairing under way.

risks.label: GDPR non-compliance
risks.description: Non-compliant processing of personal data (legal basis, retention periods, incomplete records, processor oversight). Feared event: sanction from the supervisory authority and loss of trust.
risks.comment: Tracked by the DPO; a compliance plan is under way.

risks.label: Critical supplier delay
risks.description: Failure or delay of a critical supplier (hardware, software, managed service) affecting availability or lead times. Feared event: supply chain disruption.
risks.comment: Strong dependence on a single supplier for some components; dual sourcing initiated.

risks.label: Contractual dispute
risks.description: Contractual dispute with a client or partner (SLA interpretation, allocation of responsibilities). Feared event: litigation and legal costs. Risk assessed as tolerable.
risks.comment: Accepted residual risk (tolerable): no dedicated mitigation, annual review. Illustration of a tolerated/accepted risk.

risks.label: Site fire
risks.description: Physical incident (fire) affecting the site hosting equipment. Feared event: destruction of assets and prolonged downtime.
risks.comment: Detection/suppression in place; residual risk transferred via an insurance policy.

risks.label: Ransomware attack
risks.description: Malicious encryption of the IS by ransomware, often preceded by exfiltration (double extortion). Path: initial access (phishing / exposed VPN) → privilege escalation → propagation → encryption. Feared event: IS shutdown and ransom demand.
risks.comment: Priority scenario. Defense in depth: offline backups, EDR, SOC.

risks.label: Compromise via a third party
risks.description: Pivot attack via a third party or a third-party component (trojanized update, poorly controlled partner access). EBIOS RM strategic scenario: a stakeholder becomes an attack path. Feared event: intrusion into the IS via a trusted third party.
risks.comment: Strengthening the supplier security assurance plan and third-party audits.

risks.label: Targeted espionage / exfiltration
risks.description: Persistent espionage campaign (APT) targeting strategic information, run by a structured and well-resourced source. Feared event: stealthy, long-term exfiltration of sensitive data.
risks.comment: Advanced threat: SOC detection and network segmentation are priorities.

risks.label: Denial of service (DDoS)
risks.description: Volumetric or application-layer saturation of Internet-facing services. Hacktivist or cybercriminal source (extortion). Feared event: unavailability of online services.
risks.comment: Internet-facing services; anti-DDoS protection and CDN in place.

risks.label: Cloud misconfiguration
risks.description: Misconfiguration of a cloud service (storage made public, excessive permissions) exposing data. Source: human error or lack of review. Feared event: accidental data exposure.
risks.comment: Strengthening Infrastructure as Code and configuration review (CSPM).

measures.label: Encryption + access control + DLP
measures.description: Encryption of data at rest and in transit, privileged access management (least privilege, MFA) and data loss prevention (DLP).
measures.comment: Baseline in place; annual review of privileged accounts.

measures.label: Redundancy + disaster recovery plan (DRP)
measures.description: Redundancy of critical components and a tested disaster recovery plan (failover, defined RTO/RPO).
measures.comment: Failover being hardened; next DRP test in Q3.

measures.label: Documentation + pairing
measures.description: Formalization of administration procedures and pairing to reduce dependence on key people.

measures.label: Audit + records of processing + DPO
measures.description: Maintenance of the records of processing, appointment of a DPO, regular GDPR compliance audits and processor oversight.

measures.label: Dual sourcing + buffer stock
measures.description: Diversification of critical suppliers and a buffer stock to absorb supply disruptions.

measures.label: Detection + suppression + insurance
measures.description: Fire detection, automatic suppression and transfer of the residual risk via an insurance policy.
measures.comment: Physical controls and insurance policy up to date.

measures.label: Offline backups + EDR + training
measures.description: Immutable / offline backups (3-2-1 rule), EDR on endpoints and servers, phishing awareness training.
measures.comment: EDR deployed at 80%; quarterly awareness campaign.

measures.label: Supplier security assurance plan + third-party audits
measures.description: Contractual security requirements (security assurance plan), third-party assessment and audit, control of partner access.

measures.label: Network segmentation + 24/7 SOC
measures.description: Network partitioning (segmentation, filtering) and continuous security monitoring (SOC / SIEM) with anomaly detection.
measures.comment: Outsourced SOC in place; segmentation being extended.

measures.label: Anti-DDoS protection + CDN
measures.description: Volumetric anti-DDoS protection and CDN delivery to absorb spikes and filter malicious traffic.
measures.comment: Service in place; regular load tests.

measures.label: IaC + configuration review + CSPM
measures.description: Infrastructure as Code, configuration reviews and a cloud posture tool (CSPM) to prevent accidental exposure.
measures.comment: CSPM PoC planned; IaC industrialization scheduled.

treatments.comment: Encryption, least privilege and DLP reduce the likelihood and extent of a breach.
GDPR compliance and minimization limit the exposure of personal data.
The SOC detects abnormal access and exfiltration attempts.
Redundancy and the DRP reduce downtime duration.
Documentation and pairing reduce dependence on key people.
Records, DPO and audits ensure compliance and reduce the risk of sanction.
Encryption contributes to protecting personal data.
Dual sourcing and buffer stock absorb supply disruptions.
Third-party audits and the security assurance plan reduce the likelihood of supplier failure.
Detection and suppression limit damage; insurance transfers the residual risk.
Offline backups, EDR and training limit impact and propagation.
The SOC detects the intrusion and speeds up the response.
Access control hinders privilege escalation and propagation.
The security assurance plan and third-party audits reduce the risk of compromise via a third party.
The SOC monitors partner access and detects pivots.
Segmentation and SOC detect and slow down targeted exfiltration.
Encryption and access control limit the value of exfiltrated data.
Anti-DDoS protection absorbs saturation and keeps the service available.
The SOC detects the attack and coordinates the response.
IaC and CSPM prevent and detect configuration errors.
Audits verify configuration compliance.

description.fr: Méthode EBIOS Risk Manager de l'ANSSI pour apprécier et traiter les risques numériques par scénarios stratégiques et opérationnels
description.en: ANSSI's EBIOS Risk Manager method to assess and treat digital risks through strategic and operational scenarios
description.it: Metodo EBIOS Risk Manager dell'ANSSI per valutare e trattare i rischi digitali tramite scenari strategici e operativi

description.it: Norma internazionale per la gestione dei rischi di sicurezza delle informazioni, complementare alla ISO 27001

description.fr: Politique de sécurité du système d'information définissant les règles et objectifs de sécurité de l'organisation
description.en: Information system security policy defining the organisation's security rules and objectives
description.it: Politica di sicurezza del sistema informativo che definisce le regole e gli obiettivi di sicurezza dell'organizzazione

description.fr: Acteur motivé par le gain financier, recourant à rançongiciels, fraude ou revente de données volées
description.en: Actor driven by financial gain, using ransomware, fraud or resale of stolen data
description.it: Attore mosso dal guadagno economico, che ricorre a ransomware, frode o rivendita di dati rubati

description.fr: Acteur soutenu par un État menant de l'espionnage ou du sabotage à des fins stratégiques
description.en: State-sponsored actor conducting espionage or sabotage for strategic purposes
description.it: Attore sostenuto da uno Stato che conduce spionaggio o sabotaggio per fini strategici

description.fr: Acteur militant cherchant à défendre une cause idéologique par des attaques visibles ou des divulgations
description.en: Activist actor seeking to defend an ideological cause through visible attacks or disclosures
description.it: Attore militante che difende una causa ideologica tramite attacchi visibili o divulgazioni

description.fr: Organisation rivale cherchant à obtenir un avantage économique par espionnage industriel ou déstabilisation
description.en: Rival organisation seeking economic advantage through industrial espionage or destabilisation
description.it: Organizzazione rivale che cerca un vantaggio economico tramite spionaggio industriale o destabilizzazione

description.fr: Membre interne abusant de ses accès légitimes pour nuire, détourner ou exfiltrer des informations
description.en: Internal member abusing legitimate access to harm, divert or exfiltrate information
description.it: Membro interno che abusa dei propri accessi legittimi per danneggiare, sottrarre o esfiltrare informazioni

description.fr: Faute non intentionnelle d'un utilisateur ou administrateur entraînant une exposition ou une altération des données
description.en: Unintentional mistake by a user or administrator leading to data exposure or alteration
description.it: Errore involontario di un utente o amministratore che causa esposizione o alterazione dei dati

description.fr: Fournisseur ou sous-traitant dont les accès ou défaillances peuvent compromettre le système d'information
description.en: Supplier or subcontractor whose access or failures may compromise the information system
description.it: Fornitore o subappaltatore i cui accessi o guasti possono compromettere il sistema informativo

description.fr: Événement environnemental (panne, incendie, dégât des eaux) affectant la disponibilité des systèmes et des données
description.en: Environmental event (outage, fire, water damage) affecting the availability of systems and data
description.it: Evento ambientale (guasto, incendio, allagamento) che compromette la disponibilità di sistemi e dati

description.fr: Pertes financières directes ou indirectes : fraude, interruption d'activité, sanctions ou coûts de remédiation
description.en: Direct or indirect financial losses: fraud, business interruption, penalties or remediation costs
description.it: Perdite finanziarie dirette o indirette: frode, interruzione dell'attività, sanzioni o costi di ripristino

description.fr: Conséquences légales et réglementaires, notamment sanctions RGPD, contentieux ou manquements contractuels
description.en: Legal and regulatory consequences, notably GDPR penalties, litigation or contractual breaches
description.it: Conseguenze legali e normative, in particolare sanzioni GDPR, contenziosi o inadempimenti contrattuali

description.fr: Atteinte à l'image et à la confiance des clients, partenaires et du public envers l'organisation
description.en: Damage to the image and trust of clients, partners and the public towards the organisation
description.it: Danno all'immagine e alla fiducia di clienti, partner e pubblico nei confronti dell'organizzazione

description.fr: Perturbation des activités et processus métier : indisponibilité, dégradation de service ou perte de production
description.en: Disruption of business activities and processes: unavailability, service degradation or production loss
description.it: Perturbazione delle attività e dei processi aziendali: indisponibilità, degrado del servizio o perdita di produzione

description.fr: Atteinte à la sécurité ou à l'intégrité des personnes, incluant les risques pour la santé et la sûreté
description.en: Harm to the safety or integrity of individuals, including risks to health and physical safety
description.it: Danno alla sicurezza o all'integrità delle persone, inclusi i rischi per la salute e l'incolumità

description.fr: Compromission de données personnelles : divulgation, altération ou perte affectant les personnes concernées
description.en: Compromise of personal data: disclosure, alteration or loss affecting the data subjects
description.it: Compromissione di dati personali: divulgazione, alterazione o perdita che colpisce gli interessati

description.fr: Comprendre le contexte, les actifs et les risques pour gouverner la cybersécurité (fonction Identify du NIST CSF)
description.en: Understand context, assets and risks to govern cybersecurity (NIST CSF Identify function)
description.it: Comprendere contesto, asset e rischi per governare la cybersicurezza (funzione Identify del NIST CSF)

description.fr: Mettre en place les mesures de protection limitant l'impact d'un incident (fonction Protect du NIST CSF)
description.en: Implement safeguards to limit the impact of an incident (NIST CSF Protect function)
description.it: Attuare le misure di protezione per limitare l'impatto di un incidente (funzione Protect del NIST CSF)

description.fr: Identifier rapidement la survenue d'un événement de cybersécurité (fonction Detect du NIST CSF)
description.en: Promptly identify the occurrence of a cybersecurity event (NIST CSF Detect function)
description.it: Individuare tempestivamente il verificarsi di un evento di cybersicurezza (funzione Detect del NIST CSF)

description.fr: Agir face à un incident détecté pour en contenir et réduire les effets (fonction Respond du NIST CSF)
description.en: Act on a detected incident to contain and reduce its effects (NIST CSF Respond function)
description.it: Agire di fronte a un incidente rilevato per contenerne e ridurne gli effetti (funzione Respond del NIST CSF)

description.fr: Restaurer les capacités et services altérés par un incident (fonction Recover du NIST CSF)
description.en: Restore capabilities and services impaired by an incident (NIST CSF Recover function)
description.it: Ripristinare le capacità e i servizi compromessi da un incidente (funzione Recover del NIST CSF)

description.fr: Mesure reposant sur des dispositifs technologiques : chiffrement, cloisonnement, journalisation ou contrôle d'accès
description.en: Control based on technological means: encryption, segmentation, logging or access control
description.it: Misura basata su strumenti tecnologici: cifratura, segmentazione, registrazione o controllo degli accessi

description.fr: Mesure relevant de la gouvernance et des procédures : politiques, sensibilisation, gestion des rôles et responsabilités
description.en: Control relating to governance and procedures: policies, awareness, management of roles and responsibilities
description.it: Misura relativa a governance e procedure: politiche, sensibilizzazione, gestione di ruoli e responsabilità

description.fr: Mesure de sécurité physique protégeant locaux, équipements et supports contre les accès et sinistres
description.en: Physical security control protecting premises, equipment and media against access and incidents
description.it: Misura di sicurezza fisica che protegge locali, apparecchiature e supporti da accessi e sinistri

description.fr: Mesure de nature contractuelle ou réglementaire : clauses, engagements de conformité et obligations de sous-traitance
description.en: Control of a contractual or regulatory nature: clauses, compliance commitments and subcontracting obligations
description.it: Misura di natura contrattuale o normativa: clausole, impegni di conformità e obblighi di subappalto

description.fr: Mesure diminuant la probabilité qu'un scénario de risque se réalise
description.en: Control reducing the likelihood of a risk scenario occurring
description.it: Misura che riduce la probabilità che uno scenario di rischio si realizzi

description.fr: Mesure limitant l'ampleur des conséquences si le scénario de risque se produit
description.en: Control limiting the severity of consequences should the risk scenario occur
description.it: Misura che limita l'entità delle conseguenze qualora lo scenario di rischio si verifichi

description.fr: Mesure permettant de repérer la survenue du scénario de risque afin de réagir
description.en: Control enabling detection of the risk scenario's occurrence in order to react
description.it: Misura che consente di rilevare il verificarsi dello scenario di rischio per poter reagire

description.fr: Mesure reportant tout ou partie du risque vers un tiers, par assurance ou externalisation
description.en: Control transferring all or part of the risk to a third party, through insurance or outsourcing
description.it: Misura che trasferisce in tutto o in parte il rischio a terzi, tramite assicurazione o esternalizzazione
